text: 2.83 De- Registration Registering authority may de-register an RCMC holder for a specified period for violation of conditions of registration. Before such de-registration, RCMC holder shall be given a show cause notice by registering authority, and an adequate and reasonable opportunity to make a representation against the proposed de- registration. Upon de– registration, concerned EPC shall intimate the same to all RAs.
